        } else if (ruleSet.answered === 'answered_specific') {
          survey.answers.forEach(function (survey_answer) {
            if ((survey_answer.answer == ruleSet.specific_answer) || (survey_answer.answer == ruleSet.specific_answer_value)) {
              newIndex = ruleSet.action_question_index;
            }
          });
        } else if (ruleSet.answered === 'not_answered_specific') {
          newIndex = ruleSet.action_question_index;
          survey.answers.forEach(function (survey_answer) {
            if ((survey_answer.answer == ruleSet.specific_answer) || (survey_answer.answer == ruleSet.specific_answer_value)) {
              newIndex = currentIndex + 1;
            }
          });
        }
      });

      newIndex = newIndex !== undefined ? newIndex : currentIndex + 1; // no rules were applied, go to next question

      if (typeof survey.question_count === 'number' && newIndex + 1 > survey.question_count) { // next question index can't be above question_count
        newIndex = currentIndex;
      }

      return newIndex;
    }

    function getPreviousQuestionIndex(survey) {
      var currentIndex = getSurveyActiveItemIndex(survey);
      var previousIndex;

      /* check survey rules */
      survey.rules.forEach(function (ruleSet) {
        if (ruleSet.action !== 'skip_to_question' || ruleSet.action_question_index !== currentIndex) {
          return;
        }
        if (ruleSet.answered === 'answered') {
          previousIndex = ruleSet.question_index;
        } else if (ruleSet.answered === 'answered_specific') {
          var questionElement = survey.ml_carousel_items[ruleSet.question_index];
          var cta = questionElement.querySelector('.active a');
          var questionSurvey = getSurvey(cta);

          questionSurvey.answers.forEach(function (survey_answer) {
            if ((survey_answer.answer == ruleSet.specific_answer) || (survey_answer.answer == ruleSet.specific_answer_value)) {
              previousIndex = ruleSet.question_index;
            }
          });
        } else if (ruleSet.answered === 'not_answered_specific') {
          var questionElement = survey.ml_carousel_items[ruleSet.question_index];
          var cta = questionElement.querySelector('.active a');
          var questionSurvey = getSurvey(cta);

          previousIndex = ruleSet.question_index;

          questionSurvey.answers.forEach(function (survey_answer) {
            if ((survey_answer.answer == ruleSet.specific_answer) || (survey_answer.answer == ruleSet.specific_answer_value)) {
              previousIndex = currentIndex > 0 ? currentIndex - 1 : currentIndex;
            }
          });
        }
      });

      if (typeof previousIndex === 'undefined') {
        previousIndex = currentIndex > 0 ? currentIndex - 1 : currentIndex;
      }

      return previousIndex;
    }

    function submit_survey_answer(survey) {
      if (survey.error) return;

      if (survey.quiz_mode) {
        submit_survey_quiz_answer(survey);
      }

      var request = new XMLHttpRequest();
      var body = {
                'groot_id': '26220011',
                'survey_location_url': window.location.href,
                'survey_id': survey.survey_id,
                'question_id': survey.question_id,
                'question_index': getSurveyActiveItemIndex(survey),
                'next_question_index': survey.next_question_index,
                'question_type': survey.question_type,
                'question': survey.question,
                'answers': survey.answers,
                'rules': survey.rules
            };

            if (window.ml_guid_string) {
                body['guid'] = window.ml_guid_string;
            }

      body.correct_answers_rate = window.survey_correct_answers_rate || 0;
      body.is_last_question = isLastQuestion(survey, body.next_question_index);

      if (survey.collect_answers) { // vertical survey
        Array.from(survey.ml_carousel_items).forEach(function (carousel_item, index) {
          if (carousel_item === survey.ml_carousel_item && survey.ml_carousel_items.length >= index) {
            body.question_index = index;
          }
        })

        addOrUpdateVerticalAnswers(body);
        return;
      }

      

      if (typeof survey.correct_quiz_answer !== 'undefined') {
        body['correct_quiz_answer'] = survey.correct_quiz_answer;
      }

      request.onreadystatechange = function () {
        if (request.readyState !== 4 || request.status !== 200) {
          return false;
        }

        var response = JSON.parse(request.responseText);

        if (!response || !response.success) {
          /* on request fail */
          setSurveyActiveItemIndex(survey, survey.original_index);
        }
      };

      var request_url = '{$survey}';
      

      if (survey.submit_all_answers) {
        window.verticalSurvey.request_url = request_url;
        return; // data will be submitted by webforms script
      }

      if (/^https?:\/\/.*$/i.test(request_url)) {
        request.open('POST', request_url, true);
        request.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/json;charset=UTF-8");
        request.send(JSON.stringify(body));
      }
    }

    function submit_survey_quiz_answer(survey) {
      if (typeof survey.cta.dataset.correct_quiz_answer === 'undefined') {
        /* means that this question do not have any answers */
        /* most probably it's Intro type */
        return true;
      }

      survey.correct_quiz_answer = survey.cta.dataset.correct_quiz_answer === 'true' ? '1' : '0';

      /* initialize */
      window.survey_total_questions = window.survey_total_questions || 0;
      window.survey_correct_answers = window.survey_correct_answers || 0;
      window.survey_correct_answers_rate = window.survey_correct_answers_rate || 0;
      window.quiz_mode_answers = window.quiz_mode_answers || [];


      /* increase results */
      window.survey_total_questions++;
      if (survey.cta.dataset.correct_quiz_answer === 'true') {
        window.survey_correct_answers++;
      }

      /* recalculate results */
      if (window.survey_total_questions) {
        window.survey_correct_answers_rate = Math.round(window.survey_correct_answers / window.survey_total_questions * 100 * 100) / 100;
      }

      /* insert answer to quiz_mode_answers array */
      window.quiz_mode_answers[survey.original_index] = {
        answers: [survey.cta.dataset.answer_id]
      };

      /* insert quiz results to localStorage too */
      if (window.localStorage) {
        window.localStorage.setItem('survey_total_questions', window.survey_total_questions);
        window.localStorage.setItem('survey_correct_answers', window.survey_correct_answers);
        window.localStorage.setItem('survey_correct_answers_rate', window.survey_correct_answers_rate);
        window.localStorage.setItem('quiz_mode_answers', JSON.stringify(window.quiz_mode_answers));
      }

      /* print quiz results */
      print_survey_quiz_results(survey);
    }

    function print_survey_quiz_results(survey) {
      /* print results */
      changeInnerTextForElements(
              survey.survey_total_questions_element,
              window.survey_total_questions
      );

      changeInnerTextForElements(
              survey.survey_correct_answers_element,
              window.survey_correct_answers
      );

      changeInnerTextForElements(
              survey.survey_correct_answers_rate_element,
              window.survey_correct_answers_rate
      );

      var quiz_results_details_items = [];
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(survey.quiz_results_details, function (el) {
        var items = el.getElementsByClassName('ml-survey-quiz_results-item');
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(items, function (ell) {
          quiz_results_details_items.push(ell);
        });
      });

      /* reset all .active items */

      Array.prototype.forEach.call(survey.quiz_results_details, function (el) {
        el.querySelectorAll('.active').forEach(function (item) {
          removeClass(item, 'active');
        });
      });

      window.quiz_mode_answers.forEach(function (answer, key) {
        if (!answer) {
          return; /* continue */
        }

        if (quiz_results_details_items && quiz_results_details_items[key]) {
          addClass(quiz_results_details_items[key], 'quiz_answered_item');
          answer.answers.forEach(function (item) {
            var answer_item = quiz_results_details_items[key].querySelector('[data-answer_id="' + item + '"]');

            if (answer_item) {
              var choice_answer = findParentAndSelfByClassName('ml-carousel-choice-answer', answer_item);
              addClass(choice_answer, 'active');
            }
          });
        }
      });
    }

    function findParentAndSelfByClassName(className, element) {
      if (!element) {
        return false;
      }

      if (typeof element.classList !== 'undefined' && element.classList.contains(className)) {
        return element;
      }

      return findParentAndSelfByClassName(className, element.parentNode);
    }

    function getAnswers(survey) {
      var answers = [];

      /* search for answer on cta */
      if (survey.cta.dataset.answer) {
        answers.push(getAnswer(
                survey.cta.dataset.answer,
                survey.cta.dataset.answer_id,
                survey.cta
        ));
      }

      /* search for answer on input fields */
      if (survey.input_answer.length && typeof survey.input_answer[0].value !== 'undefined') {
        answers.push(getAnswer(
                survey.input_answer[0].value,
                survey.input_answer[0].dataset.answer_id,
                survey.input_answer[0]
        ));
      }

      /* search for answers in radios or checkboxes */
      if (survey.choices.length) {
        for (var i = 0; i < survey.choices.length; i++) {
          if (hasClass(survey.choices[i], 'active')) {
            var selectedChoice = survey.choices[i].querySelector('a');
            var otherAnswerInput = getOtherAnswerInputValue(survey, selectedChoice);

            answers.push(getAnswer(
                    selectedChoice.innerText.trim() || selectedChoice.dataset.default_answer,
                    selectedChoice.dataset.answer_id,
                    selectedChoice,
                    selectedChoice.dataset.matrix_row || '',
                    selectedChoice.dataset.matrix_row_id || '',
                    otherAnswerInput || ''
            ));
          }
        }
      }

      /* if no answers - submit empty answer */
      if (!answers.length) {
        answers.push({
          answer: '',
          answer_id: 0
        });
      }

      return answers;
    }

    function getAnswer(answer, answer_id, element, matrix_row, matrix_row_id, content) {
      answer = {
        answer: answer,
        answer_id: answer_id
      };

      if (matrix_row && matrix_row_id) {
        answer.matrix_row = matrix_row;
        answer.matrix_row_id = matrix_row_id;
      }

      if (content) answer.content = content;

      var images = element.querySelectorAll('img');
      if (images && images.length) {
        var last_image = images[images.length - 1];

        if (last_image && last_image.getAttribute('src')) {
          answer['image'] = last_image.getAttribute('src');
        }
      }

      return answer;
    }

    function getSurvey(element) {
      var survey = {};

      if (findParentAndSelfByClassName('ml-carousel-go-back-button', element)) { // clicked on back button
        var ml_carousel = element.closest('.ml-carousel');
        var survey_id = ml_carousel.dataset.survey_id || Object.keys(window.survey_index)[0];
        var currentIndex = window.survey_index[survey_id];
        element = document.querySelectorAll('.ml-carousel-item')[currentIndex].querySelector('.ml-carousel-cta')
      }
      survey.cta = findParentAndSelfByClassName('ml-carousel-cta', element);
      if (!survey.cta) {
        return false;
      }

      if (findParentAndSelfByClassName('ml-survey-submit-all', survey.cta)) {
          survey.submit_all_answers = true;
          return survey;
      }

      survey.ml_carousel_car = findParentAndSelfByClassName('ml-carousel-car', survey.cta);
      survey.ml_carousel = findParentAndSelfByClassName('ml-carousel', survey.ml_carousel_car);
      survey.ml_carousel_item = findParentAndSelfByClassName('ml-carousel-item', survey.cta);
      survey.ml_carousel_items = survey.ml_carousel_car.getElementsByClassName('ml-carousel-item');

      if (!survey.ml_carousel_car || !survey.ml_carousel || !survey.ml_carousel_item) {
        return false;
      }

      survey.input_answer = survey.ml_carousel_item.getElementsByClassName('ml-carousel-input-answer');
      survey.choices = survey.ml_carousel_item.getElementsByClassName('ml-carousel-choice-answer');
      survey.active_item_index = survey.ml_carousel.getElementsByClassName('ml-carousel-active-item-index');
      survey.error_container = survey.ml_carousel_item.getElementsByClassName('ml-survey-error-message');

      survey.webform_id = '';

      survey.survey_id = survey.ml_carousel.dataset.survey_id;
      survey.question_id = survey.cta.dataset.question_id;
      survey.question_type = survey.cta.dataset.question_type;
      survey.question = survey.cta.dataset.question;
      survey.question_count = Number(survey.ml_carousel.dataset.survey_question_count);
      survey.link = survey.cta.dataset.link || survey.cta.href;
      survey.target = survey.cta.dataset.target || survey.cta.target || '_blank';
      survey.matrix_data = survey.cta.dataset.matrix_data ? decodeURIComponent(survey.cta.dataset.matrix_data) : null;
      survey.answers = getAnswers(survey);
      survey.error = validateAnswers(survey);

      /* quiz mode */
      survey.quiz_mode = survey.ml_carousel.dataset.quiz_mode === "true";
      survey.survey_total_questions_element =
              survey.ml_carousel.getElementsByClassName('ml-survey-quiz_mode-total_questions');
      survey.survey_correct_answers_element =
              survey.ml_carousel.getElementsByClassName('ml-survey-quiz_mode-correct_answers');
      survey.survey_correct_answers_rate_element =
              survey.ml_carousel.getElementsByClassName('ml-survey-quiz_mode-correct_answers_rate');
      survey.survey_start_again_button =
              survey.ml_carousel.getElementsByClassName('ml-survey-quiz_mode-start_again');
      survey.survey_show_results_button =
              survey.ml_carousel.getElementsByClassName('ml-survey-quiz_mode-show_results');
      survey.quiz_results_details =
              survey.ml_carousel.getElementsByClassName('ml-survey-quiz_mode-results');

      survey.ml_carousel_offsetWidth = parseInt(survey.ml_carousel.offsetWidth);
      survey.ml_carousel_car_offsetWidth = parseInt(survey.ml_carousel_car.offsetWidth);
      survey.original_index = getSurveyActiveItemIndex(survey);
      survey.collect_answers = survey.ml_carousel.dataset.survey_layout === "vertical";

      var survey_rules_key = '' || survey.survey_id;
      survey.rules = window.survey_rules[survey_rules_key] || [];

      survey.next_question_index = getNextQuestionIndex(survey);

      surveyGlobal = survey;
      return survey;
    }

    function validateAnswers(survey) {
      function validateSingleAnswer(el) {
        if (!el.dataset || !el.dataset.validate) return '';
        var type = el.dataset.validate;
        var error = el.dataset.error;
        var value = el.value;
        var errorMessage = '';

        if (!value) {
          return errorMessage;
        }

        if (type === 'date') {
          if (!moment || typeof moment !== "function") {
            return errorMessage;
          }

          var allowedDateFormats = ['YYYY-MM-DD', 'DD-MM-YYYY'];
          errorMessage = (!moment(value, allowedDateFormats, true).isValid() && error) || '';
        }

        return errorMessage;
      }

      if (survey.input_answer && survey.input_answer.length > 0) {
        return validateSingleAnswer(survey.input_answer[0]);
      }

      if (survey.question_type === 'matrix') {
        var data = JSON.parse(survey.matrix_data);

        if ( ((data && data.row_titles && data.row_titles.length) > (survey.answers && survey.answers.length))
              && survey.cta.dataset.error) {
          // All matrix rows has to be answered
          return survey.cta.dataset.error;
        }
      }

      return '';
    }

    function getSurveyById(survey_id) {
      var survey_element = window.document.getElementById('ml-survey-' + survey_id);
      var cta = survey_element.getElementsByClassName('ml-carousel-cta');
      cta = Array.prototype.filter.call(cta, function(el) {
        return !el.classList.contains('ml-carousel-go-back-button')
      })
      if (!cta.length) {
        return false;
      }

      return getSurvey(cta[0]);
    }

    function getSurveyActiveItemIndex(survey) {
      window.survey_index = window.survey_index || {};
      window.survey_index[survey.survey_id] = window.survey_index[survey.survey_id] || 0;

      return Number(window.survey_index[survey.survey_id]);
    }

    function setSurveyActiveItemIndex(survey, newIndex) {
      if (survey.ml_carousel_items && survey.ml_carousel_items.length <= newIndex) return;

      window.survey_index = window.survey_index || {};
      window.survey_index[survey.survey_id] = newIndex;

      survey.ml_carousel_car.style[slideMarginDirection] = survey.ml_carousel_offsetWidth * newIndex * -1 + 'px';
      printActiveIndex(survey);
    }

    function printActiveIndex(survey) {
      if (!survey.active_item_index.length) {
        return true;
      }

      var index = getSurveyActiveItemIndex(survey);
      index++;
      changeInnerTextForElements(survey.active_item_index, index);

      /* check if index is more than question count */
      /* if it is - hide progress */
      /* most probably, we are in quiz_results */
      if (index > survey.question_count) {
        addClass(survey.ml_carousel, 'hide_progress');
      } else {
        removeClass(survey.ml_carousel, 'hide_progress');
      }
    }

    function setActiveItem(element, itemClass, parentClass) {
      var clicked_item = element;

      var parent = findParentAndSelfByClassName(parentClass, clicked_item);
      var items = parent.getElementsByClassName(itemClass);

      var clicked_parent = findParentAndSelfByClassName(itemClass, clicked_item);

      if (clicked_item.dataset.type === 'checkbox') {
        toggleClass(clicked_parent, 'active');
      } else if (['radio', 'single-choice-item'].includes(clicked_item.dataset.type)) {
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(items, function (el) {
          removeClass(el, 'active');
          removeClass(el.querySelector('a'), 'active');
        });

        addClass(clicked_parent, 'active');
      }
    }

    function toggleOtherInput (clicked_item) {
        var ml_carousel_item = findParentAndSelfByClassName('ml-carousel-item', clicked_item);
        var otherInputWrapper = ml_carousel_item.querySelector('.ml-survey-multiple-other');

        if (!otherInputWrapper) return;

        if (clicked_item.dataset.answer_id === 'other') { // toggle when checkbox
           otherInputWrapper.style.display = (otherInputWrapper && otherInputWrapper.style.display === 'block') ? 'none' : 'block';
        } else if (['radio', 'single-choice-item'].includes(clicked_item.dataset.type)) { // clicked away when radio
            otherInputWrapper.style.display = 'none';
        }
    }

    function handleErrors(survey) {
      if (!survey.error_container || !survey.error_container.length) return;

      var container = survey.error_container[0];
      var wrapper = findParentAndSelfByClassName('ml-survey-error-wrapper', container);

      if (!wrapper) return;

      wrapper.style.display = !survey.error ? 'none' : 'block';

      if (survey.error) {
        survey.error_container[0].innerText = survey.error;
      }
    }

    function toggleClass(element, className) {
      if (element.classList) {
        element.classList.toggle(className);
      } else {
        var classes = element.className.split(" ");
        var i = classes.indexOf(className);

        if (i >= 0) {
          classes.splice(i, 1);
        } else {
          classes.push(className);
        }

        element.className = classes.join(" ");
      }
    }

    function addClass(element, className) {
      if (!hasClass(element, className)) {
        element.className += " " + className;
      }
    }

    function removeClass(element, className) {
      var newClass = ' ' + element.className.replace(/[\t\r\n]/g, ' ') + ' ';

      if (hasClass(element, className)) {
        while (newClass.indexOf(' ' + className + ' ') >= 0) {
          newClass = newClass.replace(' ' + className + ' ', ' ');
        }
        element.className = newClass.replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
      }
    }

    function hasClass(element, className) {
      var arr = element.className.split(" ");
      return arr.indexOf(className) !== -1;
    }

    function changeInnerTextForElements(elementsArray, newInnerText) {
      if (!elementsArray) {
        return false;
      }

      Array.prototype.forEach.call(elementsArray, function (el) {
        el.innerText = newInnerText;
      });
    }

    function toggleBackButton (survey, currentIndex) {
      if (survey.ml_carousel_items && survey.ml_carousel_items.length <= currentIndex) return;

    var next_question_node = survey.ml_carousel.getElementsByClassName('ml-carousel-item-' + currentIndex);
    var is_back_button_off = next_question_node.length ? !!next_question_node[0].getElementsByClassName('ml-survey-back-button-off').length : false;

      var backButton = document.querySelector('.ml-carousel-go-back-button');
      if (!backButton) return;

      backButton.style.display = (currentIndex === 0 || is_back_button_off) ? 'none' : 'block';
    }

    function addOrUpdateVerticalAnswers(newAnswer) {
      var existingAnswers = window.verticalSurvey.answers;

      var answerIndex = existingAnswers.findIndex(function (existingAnswer) {
        if (existingAnswer.question_id === newAnswer.question_id) return true;
      })

      if (answerIndex === -1) { // add
        existingAnswers.push(newAnswer);
      } else { // update
        existingAnswers.splice(answerIndex, 1);
        existingAnswers.push(newAnswer)
      }
    }

    function getOtherAnswerInputValue(survey, selectedChoice) {
      if (selectedChoice.dataset.answer_id === 'other' && survey.ml_carousel_item.querySelector('.ml-survey-multiple-other-input')) {
        return survey.ml_carousel_item.querySelector('.ml-survey-multiple-other-input').value;
      }
      return '';
    }

    function isLastQuestion(survey, next_question_index) {
        var is_last_question = survey.original_index === window.survey_questions_count - 1;

        if (window.survey_questions_count > 0 && !is_last_question && (window.survey_questions_count - 1 === next_question_index)) {
            // one question before the last can have `is_last_question = true` if the actual last question doesn't have the CTA button
            var questionElement = survey.ml_carousel_items[next_question_index];
            var cta = questionElement.querySelector('.ml-carousel-cta');
            is_last_question = cta === null;
        }

        return is_last_question;
    }
  })();

"Do you want algorithms to tell your story? Of course NOT!"

This was one of the key messages I shared with scientists and researchers at NTU Singapore last week during my talk on "Own Your Digital Brand: Your Science, Your Story." The response was incredible – so many brilliant minds asking thoughtful questions about how to take control of their professional narratives online.

Here's the thing: your brand already exists. It's what people say about you when you're not in the room. The question is whether you're actively shaping that perception or letting others (including algorithms) define who you are as a scientist.

The 3-Step Framework That Resonates

During my talk, I walked through my proven 3-step approach to personal branding:

KNOW your brand → Start by identifying your unique skills and what motivates you in your research. What's that one significant achievement from your PhD journey that you're truly proud of?

BUILD your brand → Choose ONE platform to start with (don't try to be everywhere at once), complete your profile, and focus on social serving over social selling.

GROW your brand → Be genuinely helpful in your expertise area, show your process (not just results), and connect with 2 new people every week.

What I love about this framework is that it gives you practical, actionable steps – not abstract theory about "building your presence."

Why This Matters More Than Ever

Whether you're looking to advance in academia, transition to industry, become an entrepreneur, or move into advocacy, your digital brand is your gateway to opportunities. It showcases your expertise, differentiates you from peers with similar qualifications, builds your professional network, and drives career advancement.

As I shared with the researchers at NTU: decision-makers often search for candidates online. A well-curated personal brand showcasing your skills and accomplishments can significantly enhance your career growth – regardless of which direction you want to take your career.

Your science deserves to be heard. Let's make sure it's your voice telling the story.

Warm regards,
Dr. Pranoti Kshirsagar
Founder, The Science Talk

P.S. If you have questions about digital branding for scientists, or if you'd like me to speak at your institution, don't hesitate to reach out. I love connecting with researchers who are ready to amplify their impact beyond the lab.
The Science Talk

68159 Mannheim
Germany

<p style="font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;">Last month marked the end of one of the most intense proposal seasons I've experienced—five research proposals worth over €1M, submitted across Germany, Denmark, and the European Commission. While managing this alongside running The Science Talk full-time (and battling a cold), I discovered something game-changing: the right AI workflow doesn't just save time—it transforms how you approach complex projects.</p>
<p style="font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;"><br></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;"><strong>🎯 The Reality Check</strong></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;">Each funding call had its own documents, budget requirements, and application criteria. The traditional approach would have meant weeks of grinding through repetitive tasks, leaving little energy for what actually matters: strategy, storytelling, and vision.</p>
<p style="font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;">My solution? A strategic AI-powered workflow that let me focus on the high-impact work while automating the heavy lifting.</p>
<p style="font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;"><br></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;"><strong>⚡ The 6-Tool Strategic Workflow<br></strong>Here's how I used each tool strategically:</p>

<ul style="font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;">
<li><strong>Claude</strong> → Breaking the blank page with fast first drafts and initial concept development</li>
<li><strong>ChatGPT</strong> → Strategic work packages and understanding evaluation psychology</li>
<li><strong>Gemini</strong> → Literature reviews and contextual research</li>
<li><strong>Perplexity</strong> → General market research and competitive landscape analysis</li>
<li><strong>Nano Banana</strong> → Concept mockups and visual sketches for technical diagrams</li>
<li><strong>NapkinAI</strong> → Rapid visualization when stuck on complex concepts</li>
</ul>
<p style="font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;">The key insight? <strong>No single tool does everything.</strong> Success comes from knowing which tool excels where and layering them strategically.</p>
<p style="font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;"><strong><br></strong></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;"><strong>💡 What Actually Worked (And What Didn't)</strong></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;">Here's what I learned from managing €1M worth of proposals with AI assistance:</p>
<p style="font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;"><em>What eliminated the grind:</em> Automated literature reviews, rapid budget iterations, and visual concept development
<em>What stayed entirely human:</em> Strategic positioning, understanding funder priorities, and the critical "why this project matters" narrative
<em>The surprise win:</em> AI helped me spot gaps in logic and strengthen weak arguments I might have missed</p>
<p style="font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;"><br></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;"><strong>📊 The Full Breakdown</strong></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;">I've documented the complete workflow—specific tools, exact prompts, what worked, what failed, and real examples from each proposal—because I believe this approach could transform how researchers tackle large-scale applications.</p>
<p style="font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;">The methodology isn't just about speed; it's about maintaining quality while scaling your capacity to pursue ambitious projects.</p>
<p style="font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;"><br></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;"><strong>🎁 Your Strategic Advantage</strong></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;">For those ready to explore this approach, I've created a comprehensive resource that includes:</p>
<p style="font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;">✅ The complete AI-assisted Proposal Writing Workflow (Visuals Edition)<br>
✅ Specific tools and prompts I use for proposal visuals<br>
✅ Strategic templates for different funding types<br>
✅ Real examples from successful applications</p>
<p style="font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;"><strong><a href="https://thesciencetalk.com/ai-proposal-writing-workflow-visuals/" style="color: #ff5757; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: underline;" data-link-id="165881183353177247">Download your free AI-assisted Proposal Writing Workflow →</a></strong></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;">This resource is designed to help you prepare your next proposal with the same strategic approach that helped me manage multiple complex applications efficiently.</p>
<p style="font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;"><br></p>

    function goToPreviousQuestion(survey) {

    function getNextQuestionIndex(survey) {
      var currentIndex = getSurveyActiveItemIndex(survey);
      var newIndex;

      /* check survey rules */
      survey.rules.forEach(function (ruleSet) {
        if (ruleSet.action !== 'skip_to_question' || ruleSet.question_index !== currentIndex) {
          return;
        }
        if (ruleSet.answered === 'answered') {
          newIndex = ruleSet.action_question_index;
        } else if (ruleSet.answered === 'answered_specific') {
          survey.answers.forEach(function (survey_answer) {
            if ((survey_answer.answer == ruleSet.specific_answer) || (survey_answer.answer == ruleSet.specific_answer_value)) {
              newIndex = ruleSet.action_question_index;
            }
          });
        } else if (ruleSet.answered === 'not_answered_specific') {
          newIndex = ruleSet.action_question_index;
          survey.answers.forEach(function (survey_answer) {
            if ((survey_answer.answer == ruleSet.specific_answer) || (survey_answer.answer == ruleSet.specific_answer_value)) {
              newIndex = currentIndex + 1;
            }
          });
        }
      });

      newIndex = newIndex !== undefined ? newIndex : currentIndex + 1; // no rules were applied, go to next question

      if (typeof survey.question_count === 'number' && newIndex + 1 > survey.question_count) { // next question index can't be above question_count
        newIndex = currentIndex;
      }

      return newIndex;
    }

    function getPreviousQuestionIndex(survey) {
      var currentIndex = getSurveyActiveItemIndex(survey);
      var previousIndex;

      /* check survey rules */
      survey.rules.forEach(function (ruleSet) {
        if (ruleSet.action !== 'skip_to_question' || ruleSet.action_question_index !== currentIndex) {
          return;
        }
        if (ruleSet.answered === 'answered') {
          previousIndex = ruleSet.question_index;
        } else if (ruleSet.answered === 'answered_specific') {
          var questionElement = survey.ml_carousel_items[ruleSet.question_index];
          var cta = questionElement.querySelector('.active a');
          var questionSurvey = getSurvey(cta);

          questionSurvey.answers.forEach(function (survey_answer) {
            if ((survey_answer.answer == ruleSet.specific_answer) || (survey_answer.answer == ruleSet.specific_answer_value)) {
              previousIndex = ruleSet.question_index;
            }
          });
        } else if (ruleSet.answered === 'not_answered_specific') {
          var questionElement = survey.ml_carousel_items[ruleSet.question_index];
          var cta = questionElement.querySelector('.active a');
          var questionSurvey = getSurvey(cta);

          previousIndex = ruleSet.question_index;

          questionSurvey.answers.forEach(function (survey_answer) {
            if ((survey_answer.answer == ruleSet.specific_answer) || (survey_answer.answer == ruleSet.specific_answer_value)) {
              previousIndex = currentIndex > 0 ? currentIndex - 1 : currentIndex;
            }
          });
        }
      });

      if (typeof previousIndex === 'undefined') {
        previousIndex = currentIndex > 0 ? currentIndex - 1 : currentIndex;
      }

      return previousIndex;
    }

    function submit_survey_answer(survey) {
      if (survey.error) return;

      if (survey.quiz_mode) {
        submit_survey_quiz_answer(survey);
      }

      var request = new XMLHttpRequest();
      var body = {
                'groot_id': '30974295',
                'survey_location_url': window.location.href,
                'survey_id': survey.survey_id,
                'question_id': survey.question_id,
                'question_index': getSurveyActiveItemIndex(survey),
                'next_question_index': survey.next_question_index,
                'question_type': survey.question_type,
                'question': survey.question,
                'answers': survey.answers,
                'rules': survey.rules
            };

            if (window.ml_guid_string) {
                body['guid'] = window.ml_guid_string;
            }

      body.correct_answers_rate = window.survey_correct_answers_rate || 0;
      body.is_last_question = isLastQuestion(survey, body.next_question_index);

      if (survey.collect_answers) { // vertical survey
        Array.from(survey.ml_carousel_items).forEach(function (carousel_item, index) {
          if (carousel_item === survey.ml_carousel_item && survey.ml_carousel_items.length >= index) {
            body.question_index = index;
          }
        })

        addOrUpdateVerticalAnswers(body);
        return;
      }

      

      if (typeof survey.correct_quiz_answer !== 'undefined') {
        body['correct_quiz_answer'] = survey.correct_quiz_answer;
      }

      request.onreadystatechange = function () {
        if (request.readyState !== 4 || request.status !== 200) {
          return false;
        }

        var response = JSON.parse(request.responseText);

        if (!response || !response.success) {
          /* on request fail */
          setSurveyActiveItemIndex(survey, survey.original_index);
        }
      };

      var request_url = '{$survey}';
      

      if (survey.submit_all_answers) {
        window.verticalSurvey.request_url = request_url;
        return; // data will be submitted by webforms script
      }

      if (/^https?:\/\/.*$/i.test(request_url)) {
        request.open('POST', request_url, true);
        request.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/json;charset=UTF-8");
        request.send(JSON.stringify(body));
      }
    }

    function submit_survey_quiz_answer(survey) {
      if (typeof survey.cta.dataset.correct_quiz_answer === 'undefined') {
        /* means that this question do not have any answers */
        /* most probably it's Intro type */
        return true;
      }

      survey.correct_quiz_answer = survey.cta.dataset.correct_quiz_answer === 'true' ? '1' : '0';

      /* initialize */
      window.survey_total_questions = window.survey_total_questions || 0;
      window.survey_correct_answers = window.survey_correct_answers || 0;
      window.survey_correct_answers_rate = window.survey_correct_answers_rate || 0;
      window.quiz_mode_answers = window.quiz_mode_answers || [];


      /* increase results */
      window.survey_total_questions++;
      if (survey.cta.dataset.correct_quiz_answer === 'true') {
        window.survey_correct_answers++;
      }

      /* recalculate results */
      if (window.survey_total_questions) {
        window.survey_correct_answers_rate = Math.round(window.survey_correct_answers / window.survey_total_questions * 100 * 100) / 100;
      }

      /* insert answer to quiz_mode_answers array */
      window.quiz_mode_answers[survey.original_index] = {
        answers: [survey.cta.dataset.answer_id]
      };

      /* insert quiz results to localStorage too */
      if (window.localStorage) {
        window.localStorage.setItem('survey_total_questions', window.survey_total_questions);
        window.localStorage.setItem('survey_correct_answers', window.survey_correct_answers);
        window.localStorage.setItem('survey_correct_answers_rate', window.survey_correct_answers_rate);
        window.localStorage.setItem('quiz_mode_answers', JSON.stringify(window.quiz_mode_answers));
      }

      /* print quiz results */
      print_survey_quiz_results(survey);
    }

    function print_survey_quiz_results(survey) {

    function findParentAndSelfByClassName(className, element) {
      if (!element) {
        return false;

      return findParentAndSelfByClassName(className, element.parentNode);

    function getAnswers(survey) {
      var answers = [];

      /* search for answer on cta */
      if (survey.cta.dataset.answer) {
        answers.push(getAnswer(
                survey.cta.dataset.answer,
                survey.cta.dataset.answer_id,
                survey.cta
        ));
      }

      /* search for answer on input fields */
      if (survey.input_answer.length && typeof survey.input_answer[0].value !== 'undefined') {
        answers.push(getAnswer(
                survey.input_answer[0].value,
                survey.input_answer[0].dataset.answer_id,
                survey.input_answer[0]
        ));
      }

      /* search for answers in radios or checkboxes */
      if (survey.choices.length) {
        for (var i = 0; i < survey.choices.length; i++) {
          if (hasClass(survey.choices[i], 'active')) {
            var selectedChoice = survey.choices[i].querySelector('a');
            var otherAnswerInput = getOtherAnswerInputValue(survey, selectedChoice);

            answers.push(getAnswer(
                    selectedChoice.innerText.trim() || selectedChoice.dataset.default_answer,
                    selectedChoice.dataset.answer_id,
                    selectedChoice,
                    selectedChoice.dataset.matrix_row || '',
                    selectedChoice.dataset.matrix_row_id || '',
                    otherAnswerInput || ''
            ));
          }
        }
      }

      /* if no answers - submit empty answer */
      if (!answers.length) {
        answers.push({
          answer: '',
          answer_id: 0
        });
      }

      return answers;
    }

    function getAnswer(answer, answer_id, element, matrix_row, matrix_row_id, content) {
      answer = {

      if (matrix_row && matrix_row_id) {
        answer.matrix_row = matrix_row;
        answer.matrix_row_id = matrix_row_id;

      if (content) answer.content = content;

      var images = element.querySelectorAll('img');
      if (images && images.length) {
        var last_image = images[images.length - 1];

        if (last_image && last_image.getAttribute('src')) {
          answer['image'] = last_image.getAttribute('src');
        }
      }

      return answer;
    }

    function validateAnswers(survey) {
      function validateSingleAnswer(el) {
        if (!el.dataset || !el.dataset.validate) return '';
        var type = el.dataset.validate;
        var error = el.dataset.error;
        var value = el.value;
        var errorMessage = '';

        if (!value) {
          return errorMessage;
        }

        if (type === 'date') {
          if (!moment || typeof moment !== "function") {
            return errorMessage;
          }

          var allowedDateFormats = ['YYYY-MM-DD', 'DD-MM-YYYY'];
          errorMessage = (!moment(value, allowedDateFormats, true).isValid() && error) || '';
        }

        return errorMessage;
      }

      if (survey.input_answer && survey.input_answer.length > 0) {
        return validateSingleAnswer(survey.input_answer[0]);
      }

      if (survey.question_type === 'matrix') {
        var data = JSON.parse(survey.matrix_data);

        if ( ((data && data.row_titles && data.row_titles.length) > (survey.answers && survey.answers.length))
              && survey.cta.dataset.error) {
          // All matrix rows has to be answered
          return survey.cta.dataset.error;
        }
      }

      return '';
    }

    function getSurveyById(survey_id) {
      var survey_element = window.document.getElementById('ml-survey-' + survey_id);
      var cta = survey_element.getElementsByClassName('ml-carousel-cta');
      cta = Array.prototype.filter.call(cta, function(el) {
        return !el.classList.contains('ml-carousel-go-back-button')
      })
      if (!cta.length) {
        return false;
      }

      return getSurvey(cta[0]);
    }

    function getSurveyActiveItemIndex(survey) {
      window.survey_index = window.survey_index || {};
      window.survey_index[survey.survey_id] = window.survey_index[survey.survey_id] || 0;

      return Number(window.survey_index[survey.survey_id]);
    }

    function setSurveyActiveItemIndex(survey, newIndex) {
      if (survey.ml_carousel_items && survey.ml_carousel_items.length <= newIndex) return;

      window.survey_index = window.survey_index || {};
      window.survey_index[survey.survey_id] = newIndex;

      survey.ml_carousel_car.style[slideMarginDirection] = survey.ml_carousel_offsetWidth * newIndex * -1 + 'px';
      printActiveIndex(survey);
    }

    function printActiveIndex(survey) {
      if (!survey.active_item_index.length) {
        return true;
      }

      var index = getSurveyActiveItemIndex(survey);
      index++;
      changeInnerTextForElements(survey.active_item_index, index);

      /* check if index is more than question count */
      /* if it is - hide progress */
      /* most probably, we are in quiz_results */
      if (index > survey.question_count) {
        addClass(survey.ml_carousel, 'hide_progress');
      } else {
        removeClass(survey.ml_carousel, 'hide_progress');
      }
    }

    function setActiveItem(element, itemClass, parentClass) {
      var clicked_item = element;

      var parent = findParentAndSelfByClassName(parentClass, clicked_item);
      var items = parent.getElementsByClassName(itemClass);

      var clicked_parent = findParentAndSelfByClassName(itemClass, clicked_item);

      if (clicked_item.dataset.type === 'checkbox') {
        toggleClass(clicked_parent, 'active');
      } else if (['radio', 'single-choice-item'].includes(clicked_item.dataset.type)) {
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(items, function (el) {
          removeClass(el, 'active');
          removeClass(el.querySelector('a'), 'active');
        });

        addClass(clicked_parent, 'active');
      }
    }

    function toggleOtherInput (clicked_item) {
        var ml_carousel_item = findParentAndSelfByClassName('ml-carousel-item', clicked_item);
        var otherInputWrapper = ml_carousel_item.querySelector('.ml-survey-multiple-other');

        if (!otherInputWrapper) return;

        if (clicked_item.dataset.answer_id === 'other') { // toggle when checkbox
           otherInputWrapper.style.display = (otherInputWrapper && otherInputWrapper.style.display === 'block') ? 'none' : 'block';
        } else if (['radio', 'single-choice-item'].includes(clicked_item.dataset.type)) { // clicked away when radio
            otherInputWrapper.style.display = 'none';
        }
    }

    function handleErrors(survey) {
      if (!survey.error_container || !survey.error_container.length) return;

      var container = survey.error_container[0];
      var wrapper = findParentAndSelfByClassName('ml-survey-error-wrapper', container);

      if (!wrapper) return;

      wrapper.style.display = !survey.error ? 'none' : 'block';

      if (survey.error) {
        survey.error_container[0].innerText = survey.error;
      }
    }

    function toggleClass(element, className) {
      if (element.classList) {
        element.classList.toggle(className);
      } else {
        var classes = element.className.split(" ");
        var i = classes.indexOf(className);

        if (i >= 0) {
          classes.splice(i, 1);
        } else {
          classes.push(className);
        }

        element.className = classes.join(" ");
      }
    }

    function addClass(element, className) {
      if (!hasClass(element, className)) {
        element.className += " " + className;
      }
    }

    function removeClass(element, className) {
      var newClass = ' ' + element.className.replace(/[\t\r\n]/g, ' ') + ' ';

      if (hasClass(element, className)) {
        while (newClass.indexOf(' ' + className + ' ') >= 0) {
          newClass = newClass.replace(' ' + className + ' ', ' ');
        }
        element.className = newClass.replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
      }
    }

    function hasClass(element, className) {
      var arr = element.className.split(" ");
      return arr.indexOf(className) !== -1;
    }

    function changeInnerTextForElements(elementsArray, newInnerText) {
      if (!elementsArray) {
        return false;
      }

      Array.prototype.forEach.call(elementsArray, function (el) {
        el.innerText = newInnerText;
      });
    }

    function toggleBackButton (survey, currentIndex) {
      if (survey.ml_carousel_items && survey.ml_carousel_items.length <= currentIndex) return;

    var next_question_node = survey.ml_carousel.getElementsByClassName('ml-carousel-item-' + currentIndex);
    var is_back_button_off = next_question_node.length ? !!next_question_node[0].getElementsByClassName('ml-survey-back-button-off').length : false;

      var backButton = document.querySelector('.ml-carousel-go-back-button');
      if (!backButton) return;

      backButton.style.display = (currentIndex === 0 || is_back_button_off) ? 'none' : 'block';
    }

    function addOrUpdateVerticalAnswers(newAnswer) {
      var existingAnswers = window.verticalSurvey.answers;

      var answerIndex = existingAnswers.findIndex(function (existingAnswer) {
        if (existingAnswer.question_id === newAnswer.question_id) return true;
      })

      if (answerIndex === -1) { // add
        existingAnswers.push(newAnswer);
      } else { // update
        existingAnswers.splice(answerIndex, 1);
        existingAnswers.push(newAnswer)
      }
    }

    function getOtherAnswerInputValue(survey, selectedChoice) {
      if (selectedChoice.dataset.answer_id === 'other' && survey.ml_carousel_item.querySelector('.ml-survey-multiple-other-input')) {
        return survey.ml_carousel_item.querySelector('.ml-survey-multiple-other-input').value;
      }
      return '';
    }

    function isLastQuestion(survey, next_question_index) {
        var is_last_question = survey.original_index === window.survey_questions_count - 1;

        if (window.survey_questions_count > 0 && !is_last_question && (window.survey_questions_count - 1 === next_question_index)) {
            // one question before the last can have `is_last_question = true` if the actual last question doesn't have the CTA button
            var questionElement = survey.ml_carousel_items[next_question_index];
            var cta = questionElement.querySelector('.ml-carousel-cta');
            is_last_question = cta === null;
        }

        return is_last_question;
    }
  })();

Hello helllo!

Here's what's changing: Starting now, AI tools for scientists is part of our regular coverage. Not because AI is trendy, but because there's a massive gap between what AI tools can do for researchers and what scientists are actually using—mostly due to institutional policy confusion, accuracy concerns, and data security fears. Over the past years, I've been quietly testing AI tools specifically for scientific workflows. Most are either unusable for serious research or violate institutional guidelines. But a few work brilliantly when used correctly.

If you're curious about AI tools that actually work for research without compromising accuracy or violating policies? Keep reading.👇

Did someone forward this to you?

They know something you should know: AI tools for scientists that don't violate policies. Join 500+ scientists getting weekly updates on tools that actually work.
Send me updates

The One AI Tool Scientists can Actually Use (Without Asking Permission First)

Scientists ask me all the time: "Can I use AI for research without violating my institution's policy?"

My answer? Yes. But only if you know the loophole.

Most scientists are stuck. ChatGPT invents citations. Claude hallucinates methodologies. Your university's AI committee has been "drafting guidelines" for 18 months while warning you about IP protection and data security.

Here's what changed for me: I figured out which AI tool doesn't trigger institutional red flags. I've been using it for months to turn 200+ podcast episodes into educational content.

Why NotebookLM is Different

The problem with most AI tools comes down to three things:

  1. You're uploading unpublished data, confidential research, or proprietary information
  2. The AI might use your data to train future models
  3. You're using outputs for commercial purposes

NotebookLM sidesteps all three if you follow one rule: only use published research papers as source material. Published papers are public information. No IP concerns. Google confirms your data isn't used to train models. You're using it for educational purposes. Even if your institution hasn't finalised AI guidelines, you're operating within safe boundaries.

What I Actually Tested

For The Science Talk, I uploaded 200+ podcast transcripts to NotebookLM. The results were transformative.

Here's what I can show you: The QuanTour project—twelve podcast episodes with senior researchers from twelve European quantum science labs.

I generated:

  • Flashcards with timestamp citations
  • Mind maps showing thematic connections across episodes
  • FAQs addressing conceptual barriers
  • Study guides for progressive learning
  • Audio overviews that synthesise multiple episodes into podcast-style summaries

What You Need to Know About NotebookLM

Key features that matter for scientists:

  • Flashcards and quizzes from research papers
  • Interactive mind maps showing connections across sources
  • Audio overviews in podcast format
  • Citation tracking—every output links to specific paragraphs
  • Enterprise security—your data isn't used for model training
  • 130+ language support for international collaboration

What it gets wrong:

  • Complex mathematical notation gets mangled
  • Technical jargon with multiple meanings needs manual review
  • Text-only flashcards limit use for visual-heavy fields

I had quantum episodes where only 70% of generated flashcards were immediately usable. But even that beats starting from scratch when creating educational materials.

Read the Complete Implementation Guide

This newsletter just scratches the surface. On the blog, you'll get:

  • Full 3-week implementation roadmap with timeline graphics
  • Detailed institutional policy compliance breakdown
  • Academic research backing this approach
  • Accuracy testing data from real scientific content
  • Specialised features guide (audio overviews, mind maps, video summaries)
  • Exact limitations for different scientific fields
  • Why this works for science communication (but only Phase 1)

Read the full guide on our website
Read blog

Quick Start (If You Want to Try Now)

Week 1: Upload one paper you know well. Generate flashcards. Verify accuracy.

Week 2: Upload 5-10 published papers. Create a mind map showing connections.

Week 3: Try audio overviews and study guides for literature organisation.

Share your experience. If you try NotebookLM, I'd love to hear what works (and what doesn't) in your field. Connect with me on LinkedIn or reply to this email to share your results.

Happy experimenting,

Best regards,
Dr. Pranoti Kshirsagar
Founder, The Science Talk

                            <p style="font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 16px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;">Hello there,</p>

                            <p style="font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 16px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;">I've been having the same conversation with researchers across Europe for months now. It usually starts with: <strong>"Can I actually use ChatGPT for my grant proposal?"</strong> or <strong>"Is Claude allowed for literature reviews at my university?"</strong></p>

                            <p style="font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 16px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;">The answer is frustratingly complex: it depends on your institution, your funder, and sometimes even which department you're in. One university bans commercial AI tools entirely whilst another actively encourages them. The ERC has guidelines, but they're different from what your national funding agency requires.</p>

                            <p style="font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 16px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;"><strong>Here's what I keep seeing:</strong> Brilliant researchers either playing it overly safe (avoiding helpful tools entirely) or unknowingly crossing policy boundaries they didn't know existed. Both scenarios slow down good science.</p>

                            <p style="font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 16px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;">So I built something to help cut through this confusion: <strong>a European AI Policy Database</strong> that actually answers the questions you're asking.</p>

                            <p style="font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 16px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;"><strong>What you'll find inside:</strong></p>
                            <ul style="font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 16px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px; padding-left: 20px;">
                                <li style="margin-bottom: 8px;">Direct links to AI policies from major European universities and research institutes</li>
                                <li style="margin-bottom: 8px;">Funding agency positions on generative AI (ERC, Horizon Europe, national funders)</li>
                                <li style="margin-bottom: 8px;">Specific guidance on what requires disclosure vs. approval</li>
                                <li style="margin-bottom: 8px;">Practical boundaries for different research activities</li>
                            </ul>

                            <p style="font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 16px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;">The European research landscape is shifting rapidly on this. Some institutions have comprehensive frameworks in place, others are still drafting theirs. If you're working across multiple countries or with several funding sources, you might be navigating completely different rule sets for the same project.</p>

                            <p style="font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 16px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;">This database helps you find what specifically applies to your situation rather than guessing or avoiding AI tools altogether out of caution.</p>

                            <p style="font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 16px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;"><strong><a href="https://thesciencetalk.com/european-ai-compliance-hub/" target="_blank" style="font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; color: #ff5757; text-decoration: underline;" data-link-id="167756542267884634">→ Explore the AI Policy Database here</a></strong></p>

                            <p style="font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 16px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;"><strong>And if you want to go deeper...</strong></p>

                            <p style="font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 16px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;">I'm running a hands-on workshop on <strong>11 November 2025</strong> where we'll work through exactly how to use AI tools compliantly and effectively in your research workflow. Not theoretical discussions—actual implementation strategies you can use the next day.</p>

                            <p style="font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 16px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;"><strong><a href="https://thesciencetalk.com/ai-for-scientists-compliant-ethical-powerful/" target="_blank" style="font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; color: #ff5757; text-decoration: underline;" data-link-id="167756542273127521">→ Join the workshop (11 November)</a></strong></p>

                            <p style="font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', sans-serif; color: #333333; font-size: 16px; line-height: 150%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px;"><strong>Quick question for you:</strong> What's been your biggest challenge navigating AI policies at your institution?
